bodies.name: Camera dei Deputati (Chamber of Deputies)
bodies.layout: A dense, institutional homepage led by a top utility bar with language and accessibility links, beneath which sits a masthead bearing the parliamentary crest and a mega-menu menu bar. The body is organized into a multi-column river of news items, session schedules, and committee updates, resembling a news portal more than a modern service site. A right-hand rail typically surfaces live/ongoing session status ('Aula' broadcasts) and quick links to bill tracking. The footer is dense with institutional links, legal notices, and social icons, reflecting the older Codice dell'Amministrazione Digitale-era design common to legacy .it parliamentary sites.

bodies.name: Presidenza del Consiglio dei Ministri (Governo Italiano / PM Office)
bodies.layout: A news-portal-style homepage split into a primary river of 'Notizie' (news) items on the left with headline, thumbnail, and lede text, alongside secondary sidebars for 'Dai Ministeri' (from the ministries) and an event 'Agenda' calendar widget. Government press releases about the PM's activity dominate the top of the page. The overall structure predates the newer Bootstrap Italia component system in places, mixing older Palazzo Chigi templates with newer .italia-style elements sitewide. Footer aggregates links to all ministries and related institutional portals ('Siti di interesse').

bodies.name: Autorità Nazionale Anticorruzione (ANAC - National Anti-Corruption Authority)
bodies.layout: A clean, card-based homepage clearly built on the Bootstrap Italia / .italia design system, opening with a full-width hero image and mission statement, followed by three large 'settori di intervento' (intervention areas) cards in an asymmetric layout (Trasparenza, Anticorruzione, Contratti pubblici). Below that is an 'In evidenza' news grid with dated category tags (Focus atti Anac, Primo piano, Notizie), then a live usage-statistics widget showing daily counts of CIG codes issued and tender notices. The footer is organized into clearly labeled columns (Argomenti, Contatti, Trasparenza, Link Utili) per the national design system pattern.
